A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research and contain complete main text, Appendices A–J, and the checklist. Full text comparison and rendered-page inspection support reliable matching of equations, tables, figures, and relocated material.

before.justification: v3 reports original formula-harvesting and unification results, LLM comparisons in Tables 2–3, and computational sensitivity experiments in Appendix D.

after.justification: v4 retains these original computational results, including 385 validated π formulas, LLM benchmarks, and hyperparameter sensitivity experiments.

M1.justification: The harvesting, validation, canonicalization, folding, and UMAPS procedures in Section 3 and Appendix C are unchanged. The revised asymptotic equations occur in theoretical derivations and do not establish an algorithm change.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same corpus of 455,050 articles, π-formula tasks, CMF trajectory search, and examples involving e, ζ(3), and Catalan’s constant. No dataset or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Tables 2 and 11 retain GPT-4o and Gemini 2.5 Pro Preview for equivalence detection/proving. Table 3 retains GPT-4o, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, and GPT-4o mini as extractor comparisons.

E3.justification: The ten equivalence-test pairs, temperature-zero prompts, CMF search ranges, fitting depths, and validation procedures remain unchanged. The prompts in Appendices H–I move with page reflow without changes to their content.

E4.justification: Appendix D retains the same clustering-threshold, clustering-granularity, UMAPS-depth, and Guess-depth studies in Tables 7–10. The worked examples and extraction-error cases in Appendices B and I are also unchanged.

E5.justification: The reporting of counts, percentages, and runtime estimates is unchanged. Neither version supplies different seed or repeated-run information, uncertainty intervals, error bars, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Table 4 still reports relations among 360/385 formulas and CMF unification of 166/385. LLM scores, sensitivity results, generated-formula findings, and Appendix J’s full result tables are unchanged. The dataset totals added to Appendix J were already reported in Sections 3.3 and 5.4.

T1.justification: v4 removes an intermediate convergence/boundedness argument from Lemma 3’s proof, changes the asymptotic matrix numerator in Eq. (27) from -z(z+1) to -z², and revises auxiliary sign definitions and proof completion in G.5.2. These are localized mathematical revisions; the new S definition is not consistently propagated through the subsequent verification.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and outlook retain the same automated-unification contributions, novelty claims, headline results, and generalization claims. No core contribution is added, removed, or materially rescaled.

C2.justification: The limitations concerning LLM errors, contextual symbols, and broader formula coverage are retained. Replacing 'D-finite constants' with 'constants derived from D-finite functions' clarifies terminology consistently with the existing Appendix G discussion.

D1.justification: Appendix J changes the documented supplementary files from pandas pickles to pcfs.json and cmf_pcfs.json, changes ab from a tuple to a list, and specifies rational-number encoding as a_b. It also states the existing dataset sizes explicitly, while Appendix C.5 adds a pointer to the supplementary recurrence data.

R1.justification: Reference [2] drops the description of Obrovsky’s forthcoming stronger algorithm as finding 'more general' coboundary equivalences, a limited positioning refinement. The cited-work set remains unchanged; the Sun reference update is bibliographic.

P1.justification: The glossary is reordered and rewritten with clearer terminology, accompanied by localized grammar, punctuation, and cross-reference edits. The overall section organization and narrative remain stable.

P2.justification: The glossary’s bullet formatting is replaced by reformatted entries. Table 11 moves before Section H.2, and the retained prompt boxes and nearby material reflow across Appendices H–I. Scientific figures and table structures remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: Clearer supplementary-data documentation and appendix presentation, together with the asymptotic correction in Eq. (27), provide limited benefits. However, G.5.2 changes S=s-(α+β) to S=-s-(α+β), while its verification still expands using the old definition. This introduces inconsistent algebra into an existing proof, making the net quality effect of the revision unclear.
